content:
The image shows a mango leaf with distinct dark brown-to-black irregular spots scattered across the leaf surface. The spots appear sunken/necrotic with irregular margins, and the surrounding leaf tissue remains green. No powdery coating, no sooty black film, no tip dieback pattern.

Key evidence:
- Discrete, irregular dark lesions on an otherwise green leaf
- Lesions appear necrotic and somewhat angular/irregular in shape
- Multiple spots distributed across the blade
- No signs of white powdery growth (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty coating over the surface (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No tip/branch dieback pattern (rules out Die_Back)
- Lesion pattern is classic for Anthracnose (*Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*) on mango
